title: add jsonschema strict response_format with improved error messages (openai-compat)
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Adds a consistent 'response_format' JSON Schema mode with a strict validation path for the OpenAI compatibility layer. Motivation: customers using structured outputs need deterministic validation and clear error reporting when model responses don't match schemas. This PR implements 'response_format': {type: 'json_schema', strict: true|false} semantics, server-side validation with improved, user-friendly error messages, a compatibility shim for existing openai-style requests, and opt-in tooling to return partial parses vs. errors. Changes include request parsing, validation pipeline integration, standardized error codes, and docs/SDK updates. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged (non-strict). For strict=true we return HTTP 422 with a structured error in Redwood format that includes OpenAI-compatible fields and a human readable message. See linked Linear ENG-4982 and ENG-5031 for acceptance criteria. Testing: unit tests cover schema edge cases and integration tests validate error mapping for streaming and non-streaming flows. Checklist: - [x] implement server-side validator and strict flag - [x] add OpenAI-compatible error mapping - [x] update API docs and add examples - [x] add unit and integration tests - [x] run canary on staging runtime - [x] add SDK examples in python/ts
